message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
The exact number varies with size:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~80 | ~15 |
| Medium | ~123 | ~22 |
| Large | ~182 | ~30 |

So you can expect anywhere from about 15 to 30 calories per tomato, depending on its size.
